verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile MFA, passwordless sign-in and credential app. User-defined recurring job or workflow scheduling is outside this product category, so the story is a wrong-axis question rather than a missing capability. The documented hourly location-sharing requirement is a compliance check, not a user-schedulable job, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
